description: Holds EURUSD while its 20-day average is above its 100-day average, cash otherwise. Falsified if the most liquid pair is too efficient for a medium-term trend rule. Backtested on FinzData FX daily closes (spot: the price change only, no interest differential), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: EURUSD trend · 20/100 moving average (spot)
